steps.title: Sketch the L profile
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front).
Line: draw the L shape from the origin.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): base 60 long, upright 50 high, both 5 thick. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the bracket
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 40 mm, into the screen. Click OK.

steps.title: Inside bend radius
actions: Click Fillet. Radius 6 mm. Pick the inside corner edge. Click OK.

steps.title: Outside bend radius
actions: Click Fillet. Radius 11 mm (6 inside + 5 thickness). Pick the outside corner edge. Click OK.
steps.note: Inside radius plus thickness gives an even 5 mm wall round the bend, as bent plate has.

steps.title: Cut the slot in the base
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the top of the base. Slot (Center to Center): centres 11 apart (18 long overall), 7 wide, centred 40 from the back and in the middle of the width.
Finish Sketch. Extrude, Boolean: Cut, Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Drill the hole in the upright
actions: Click Hole and click the outside face of the upright. Centre 32 up from the bottom, in the middle of the width.
Simple Hole. Diameter 8 mm. Through All. Click OK.
steps.note: You can also make this part with the Sheet Metal tools: Face, then Flange, with a 5 mm thickness and a 6 mm bend radius.
